description: Read a company page's public fields, FRESH at request time: name, website, tagline, description, industry, company type, employee count and size range, headquarters (city, region, country, postal code), founded year, specialities, follower count and affiliated pages. Costs $0.0012 per live read; a page that cannot be read is free. Pass the page's public name or its page address as `page`. Each call is a live read that usually takes 15 to 25 seconds (measured 2026-11-03), so allow at least 45 seconds before timing out. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

page.description: The company page's public name (the part after /company/) or its page address.
